Problem Statement:
Save the string “WELCOMETOGUVICORPORATIONS” in a two dimensional array of size (5*5) and search for the given substring. If it exists print the start index and end index in the matrix in separate lines. If it does not exist print 0.
input_spec: The input consists of a substring to be searched within the 5x5 matrix.
output_spec: If the substring is found, print its start index and end index in the matrix on separate lines. Otherwise, print 0.
